sources.title: GiNZA - Megagon
sources.snippet: This initiative provides large quantities of data that enable us to proceed with open and efficient improvements to the GiNZA/spaCy analytical model. Once the restructured UD Japanese GSD data set is complete, we plan to release it under the commercially usable Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike (CC BY-SA) license.

sources.title: ja_ginza_bert_large (BERT Model) | megagonlabs/ginza | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: This document covers the ja_ginza_bert_large model, which is Ginza's BERT-large based Japanese NLP model providing high-accuracy natural language processing through transformer architecture. This model represents the most computationally intensive but highest-accuracy option in the Ginza model ecosystem.
